answer: Beacon-Quill Lottery Admission. Each epoch a public verifiable random beacon emits a seed after registration closes, so attackers cannot time or grind identities to it. A quill (per-application nonce) is committed before the seed; only applications whose hash falls below an adaptive threshold—set by current participation zenith—are admitted. Losers pay the full compute and posting cost and must restart next epoch, so mass sybils face repeated sunk cost and per-identity rejection risk without any stake or burn.
